edits.after:
.

When `<directory>/inventory-view-envelope.json` and `inventory-view.jsonl` exist,
read the complete envelope and view with the same exact bounded native `dd`
calls. Start the view at offset 0, then 8064, 16128 and onward through its
actual length. This readable semantic inventory preserves global rows, roots,
holds, reasons and selection; its identity legend resolves every typed ID.
It is not a full case archive. RAW REF details remain UNINSPECTED: before any
effect, read fresh selected-root assignment authority, thread bodies, applicable
current/covered messages, dossier, history and dedup evidence as required below.
Held and deferred roots remain ineligible for action. Unknown schema or missing
compact artifacts requires the existing complete raw route; never narrow scope.
After a successful view page, a separate bounded `dd` read of
`<directory>/inventory-view-progress.json` can show the remaining range and next
exact page command. Progress is advisory; never poll it or treat it as evidence
that a page was read. Preserve genuine results through EOF before effects.
The supervisor audits this ordering after the run; engine action guards remain
the actual action gates. Neither a clean terminal nor retained proof establishes
inspection or authenticates original MIME/header bytes
